Clause 9.21.1 - heritage (heritage): The precinct contains three Heritage Conservation Areas being the David Street Heritage Conservation Area, the Inter War Group Heritage Conservation Area

Clause 9.21.1 - parking (development_control): Off street parking is generally provided on both sides of streets within the precinct. Most streets are able to accommodate off street parking without restricting vehicular access, with the exception of Jocelyn Avenue.

Clause 9.21.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.21.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identified  Heritag e Items  within the prec inct.

Clause 9.21.2 - other (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.21.2 - other (development_control): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original built form including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.21.2 - other (development_control): To protect significant streetscape s and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.21.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominantly low density residen tial character of the pre cinct.
